# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by clients/python/scripts/gen_reference.py. Do not edit. -->

Every `contractum` command, its arguments and its options. Global options go before
the command name, for example `contractum --profile prod list`. Every command also
accepts `--help`.

## `contractum`

Fetch published data contracts and test your data against them.

```text
contractum [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--version` | flag |  | Show the client version, and the server version when one is configured, and exit. |
| `--profile` | NAME |  | Connection profile to use. |
| `--url` | URL |  | Contractum API base URL. |
| `--ca-bundle` | FILE |  | PEM file with the CA certificates to trust. |
| `--allow-insecure-http` | flag |  | Allow a plain http URL (local development only). |
| `--no-color` | flag |  | Do not use colors. |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | flag |  | Print only results and errors. |

### `contractum compare`

Test DATA against two versions of a contract and show which checks changed.

Exit 0 when the target version passes, 1 when it has a failed check, 2 on any error.

```text
contractum compare [OPTIONS] DATA
```

| Argument | Required |
| --- | --- |
| `DATA` | yes |

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--contract` | REF |  | The contract: [FOLDER-PATH:]ODCS-ID-OR-UUID. |
| `--from` | VERSION | `latest` | The version to compare from: latest, preview or an exact SemVer. |
| `--to` | VERSION | `preview` | The version to compare to: latest, preview or an exact SemVer. |
| `--fail-on-deprecated` | flag |  | Fail when the contract version is deprecated. |
| `--sunset-within` | DAYS |  | Fail when the contract is scheduled to sunset within DAYS days. |
| `--format` | `parquet`, `csv`, `tsv`, `json`, `ndjson`, `delta`, `ddl` |  | Dataset format when the file suffix does not say. |
| `--object` | NAME |  | Schema object to test; needed when the contract has several. |
| `--schema-only` | flag |  | Check column names and types only, without reading rows. |
| `--dialect` | NAME |  | SQL dialect of a DDL file. |
| `--extra` | `allow`, `warn`, `fail` | `warn` | What to do with columns the contract does not list. |
| `--ignore-case` | flag |  | Match column names without regard to case. |
| `--strict-types` | flag |  | Require float or decimal columns for number, and fail (not warn) on values outside a format width. |
| `--sample` | N\|FRACTION |  | Test N random rows, or a FRACTION of the rows. |
| `--seed` | INTEGER, >= 0 | `0` | Seed of the random sample. |
| `--limit` | N |  | Test only the first N rows. |
| `--max-failures` | INTEGER, >= 0 | `5` | Failing values shown per check. |
| `--mask` | `auto`, `all`, `none` | `auto` | Hide failing values: auto by classification, all, or none. |
| `--samples`, `--no-samples` | flag |  | Show failing values (--no-samples shows none). |
| `--strict` | flag |  | Exit 1 on warnings too. |
| `--fail-on-skipped` | flag |  | Exit 1 when a check was skipped. |
| `--markdown` | PATH |  | Write a Markdown summary (for pull-request comments) to PATH. |
| `--json` | PATH\|- |  | Write the comparison as JSON to PATH, or to stdout with - (no table is printed then). |

### `contractum config`

Manage connection profiles (URL, CA bundle, insecure HTTP); never credentials.

Use the global --profile NAME option to act on a profile other than the default one, for example: contractum --profile prod config set url `https://contractum.example.com`

```text
contractum config [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

#### `contractum config get`

Print one value of the profile.

```text
contractum config get [OPTIONS] KEY
```

| Argument | Required |
| --- | --- |
| `KEY` | yes |

#### `contractum config list`

List the profiles and their values; the default profile is marked with *.

```text
contractum config list [OPTIONS]
```

#### `contractum config path`

Print the profiles file location.

```text
contractum config path [OPTIONS]
```

#### `contractum config set`

Set one value of the profile, creating the profile when needed.

```text
contractum config set [OPTIONS] KEY VALUE
```

| Argument | Required |
| --- | --- |
| `KEY` | yes |
| `VALUE` | yes |

#### `contractum config unset`

Remove one value from the profile.

```text
contractum config unset [OPTIONS] KEY
```

| Argument | Required |
| --- | --- |
| `KEY` | yes |

#### `contractum config use`

Make NAME the default profile.

```text
contractum config use [OPTIONS] NAME
```

| Argument | Required |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | yes |

### `contractum list`

List the contracts you can read, in the server's order.

```text
contractum list [OPTIONS] [QUERY]
```

| Argument | Required |
| --- | --- |
| `QUERY` | no |

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--folder` | PATH |  | Only contracts under this folder path. |
| `--domain` | DOMAIN |  | Only contracts of this domain. |
| `--status` | STATUS |  | Only contracts with this ODCS status. |
| `--tag` | TAG |  | Require a tag (repeatable). |
| `--limit` | INTEGER, >= 1 | `50` | Most contracts. |
| `--all` | flag |  | Follow every page. |
| `--json` | flag |  | Print JSON. |

### `contractum login`

Store a token for this profile after checking it with the server.

Create a personal access token in the web UI (account menu > Access tokens), or use a service-account key, then run `printf '%s' "$TOKEN" | contractum login --token -`. On a terminal, `contractum login` asks for the token without echo. Pipelines set CONTRACTUM_TOKEN instead and do not log in.

```text
contractum login [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--token` | - |  | Read the token from stdin; the value must be '-'. |

### `contractum logout`

Forget the stored token of this profile.

```text
contractum logout [OPTIONS]
```

### `contractum pull`

Pin contracts: write their files and contractum.lock.

REF is [FOLDER-PATH:]ODCS-ID-OR-UUID[@latest|@preview|@X.Y.Z]. Without REF the lock's own references are resolved again (or, with --frozen or --offline, read from the lock). A deprecated version warns; --fail-on-deprecated and --sunset-within DAYS turn that into exit code 1, after the files and the lock are written.

```text
contractum pull [OPTIONS] [REFS]...
```

| Argument | Required |
| --- | --- |
| `REFS` | no |

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--dir` | DIRECTORY | `contracts` | Directory for the pulled contract files. |
| `--lock` | FILE | `contractum.lock` | The lock file that pins versions and hashes. |
| `--frozen` | flag |  | Use only the pinned versions: never resolve latest or preview; fail on any drift. |
| `--offline` | flag |  | Use only the lock, the pulled files and the cache; no URL and no network needed. |
| `--gitattributes`, `--no-gitattributes` | flag |  | Add -text lines to .gitattributes so Git keeps the pulled bytes exact. |
| `--fail-on-deprecated` | flag |  | Fail when the contract version is deprecated. |
| `--sunset-within` | DAYS |  | Fail when the contract is scheduled to sunset within DAYS days. |
| `--json` | flag |  | Print a JSON summary. |

### `contractum show`

Print a contract: REF is [FOLDER-PATH:]ODCS-ID-OR-UUID[@latest|@preview|@X.Y.Z].

```text
contractum show [OPTIONS] REF
```

| Argument | Required |
| --- | --- |
| `REF` | yes |

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--version` | VERSION |  | latest, preview or an exact SemVer. |
| `--format` | `original`, `yaml`, `json` | `original` | original prints the stored bytes; yaml and json convert locally. |
| `--metadata` | flag |  | Print the version metadata. |
| `--report` | flag |  | Print the stored publish report. |
| `-o`, `--output` | FILE |  | Write the document to FILE. |

### `contractum test`

Test DATA (a file, a Delta table or a SQL DDL file) against a published contract.

Exit 0 when every check passed, 1 when the data does not match the contract, 2 on any error.

```text
contractum test [OPTIONS] DATA
```

| Argument | Required |
| --- | --- |
| `DATA` | yes |

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--contract` | REF |  | The contract: [FOLDER-PATH:]ODCS-ID-OR-UUID[@latest\|@preview\|@X.Y.Z]. |
| `--contract-file` | FILE |  | Use a local ODCS contract file; no server needed. |
| `--version` | VERSION |  | latest, preview or an exact SemVer; overrides the version in --contract. |
| `--lock` | FILE | `contractum.lock` | The lock file read by --frozen and --offline. |
| `--frozen` | flag |  | Use the version pinned in the lock; never resolve latest or preview. |
| `--offline` | flag |  | Use only the lock, the pulled files and the cache; no network. |
| `--fail-on-deprecated` | flag |  | Fail when the contract version is deprecated. |
| `--sunset-within` | DAYS |  | Fail when the contract is scheduled to sunset within DAYS days. |
| `--format` | `parquet`, `csv`, `tsv`, `json`, `ndjson`, `delta`, `ddl` |  | Dataset format when the file suffix does not say. |
| `--object` | NAME |  | Schema object to test; needed when the contract has several. |
| `--schema-only` | flag |  | Check column names and types only, without reading rows. |
| `--dialect` | NAME |  | SQL dialect of a DDL file. |
| `--extra` | `allow`, `warn`, `fail` | `warn` | What to do with columns the contract does not list. |
| `--ignore-case` | flag |  | Match column names without regard to case. |
| `--strict-types` | flag |  | Require float or decimal columns for number, and fail (not warn) on values outside a format width. |
| `--sample` | N\|FRACTION |  | Test N random rows, or a FRACTION of the rows. |
| `--seed` | INTEGER, >= 0 | `0` | Seed of the random sample. |
| `--limit` | N |  | Test only the first N rows. |
| `--max-failures` | INTEGER, >= 0 | `5` | Failing values shown per check. |
| `--mask` | `auto`, `all`, `none` | `auto` | Hide failing values: auto by classification, all, or none. |
| `--samples`, `--no-samples` | flag |  | Show failing values (--no-samples shows none). |
| `--strict` | flag |  | Exit 1 on warnings too. |
| `--fail-on-skipped` | flag |  | Exit 1 when a check was skipped. |
| `--json` | PATH\|- |  | Write the report as JSON to PATH, or to stdout with - (no table is printed then). |
| `--junit` | PATH |  | Write the report as JUnit XML to PATH. |
| `--markdown` | PATH |  | Write a Markdown summary (for pull-request comments) to PATH. |

### `contractum versions`

List the versions of a contract: latest, preview or older, deprecation and sunset.

```text
contractum versions [OPTIONS] REF
```

| Argument | Required |
| --- | --- |
| `REF` | yes |

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | flag |  | Print JSON. |

### `contractum whoami`

Show who the current credential belongs to (never the credential itself).

```text
contractum whoami [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Takes | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | flag |  | Print JSON. |
